_comment: One-room test world. 'entities' is both the semantic map (what the robot is told) and the scene to build. Sim objects are primitives, so 'description' states what they look like (used as the perception phrase). present_in_sim=false: the map believes the entity exists, but it is not in the scene (tests OBJECT_NOT_FOUND).

toy._note: Deliberately NOT placed in the scene: the robot's map says it exists, so mission step S4 (search toy) must end BLOCKED/OBJECT_NOT_FOUND with an entity_absent observation. Tests that perception does not report objects that are not there.
